100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 20, 1926, the world was abuzz with significant events. In Germany, Chancellor Wilhelm Marx faced mounting pressure as political instability continued to grip the Weimar Republic, raising concerns over the country's future. Meanwhile, in the United States, a severe drought was devastating agricultural regions, prompting fears of a looming economic crisis. Additionally, the ongoing negotiations for the future of the League of Nations highlighted the growing tensions in international relations.
